source.patch: After each successful os.link, use prevalidated prepared_ids instead of a new fallible _identity(path) before inserting link in rollback ledger.

defect: A successful os.link could be followed by a failing _identity(prepared[X]) before published.append. The rollback ledger then omits an already-created destination, leaving an orphan addon or receipt despite HOLD; the post-link lstat was unnecessary because a pinned inode ID was already recorded at preparation.

actualAsserts: fault injected after successful addon hardlink publication
patched isolated helper detects post-link fault and rolls back published addon
cooperative lock and temporary files removed

previousLessonApplied: R03: rollback must revert only its own proven files; R04 extends this to recording the immutable output identity BEFORE any side-effect publication and avoiding post-link fallible operations before tracking rollback.
newLesson: ERROR: successful hardlink + exception in subsequent metadata read can create an untracked output. ROOT CAUSE: rollback ledger appended only after an avoidable post-publication _identity call. FIX: pin verified temp inode at preparation and append the output using cached identity directly after os.link. REGRESSION: fault-inject metadata read after first link and assert orphan-free cleanup. PREVENTION: no fallible I/O between an irreversible publication and its rollback registration; isolate test assertions from native/full-repository acceptance.
